item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: High clouds tonight; springlike warmth continues tomorrow
item.description: The unseasonably warm weather will continue tomorrow. Temperatures will range from the low to upper 70s tomorrow, well above average for February. High clouds will continue to stream in tonight and tomorrow.

item.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery announce $110 billion deal
item.description: A massive $110 billion merger has been signed between Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount Skydance.

item.title: California's snowpack remains below average despite recent storms, survey shows
item.description: The Department of Water Resources said the snowpack is 66% of average for this date statewide, with the recent storms not enough to get the state back to average conditions for this time of year.

item.title: Santa Clara Co. resident tests positive for measles, recently visited Peninsula: health officials
item.description: Health officials said a Santa Clara County resident developed symptoms and tested positive for measles several days after returning from an international trip. The person may have also exposed diners at a Burlingame Panda Express.

item.title: Man accused of poisoning Southern California couple by spraying bug spray on food
item.description: A couple is speaking out after their roommate allegedly poisoned them, leading to a standoff with deputies. Video shows the man spraying bug spray on their groceries.

item.title: San Francisco court clerks end strike, expect to return to work Monday, union says
item.description: San Francisco Superior Court clerks say they look forward to getting back to serving the public Monday morning after a tentative agreement was reached Friday afternoon following a strike that started Thursday.

item.title: Okizu strong: How NorCal camp program helps kids with cancer, their families
item.description: Northern California nonprofit Okizu offers support to not just the kids battling cancer, but their whole families. "If one of us gets sick... we'll storm through it as a family... we'll get through it," 4-year-old Sammy said.

item.title: Disaster as fencing wire gets tangled in spinning car wash in North Carolina
item.description: The first rule of going to the car wash with your truck is make sure there's nothing in the bed. A North Carolina man found that out the hard way.

item.title: Man convicted in 2012 killing of Sierra LaMar may get a new trial after court ruling
item.description: The man convicted in the 2012 killing of Morgan Hill teen Sierra Lamar may get a new trial. This comes after the California Court of Appeals reversed Antolin Garcia-Torres' judgment on Friday, saying, "There was insufficient evidence of willful, deliberate, and premeditated murder or a specific intent to kill."

item.title: Israel's defense minister says his country has attacked Iran and declares a state of emergency
item.description: Israel launched a daylight attack Saturday on Iran's capital, with a cloud of smoke rising from the city's downtown.
